description: Goverlay is an easy graphical interface to configure linux gaming applications

summary.one_liner: Goverlay is a Qt6 graphical interface for Linux gamers that generates configs and launch commands for MangoHud, vkBasalt, vkSumi, OptiScaler and Proton tweaks.
summary.what_it_does: Goverlay provides a card-based GUI for configuring MangoHud performance overlays, vkBasalt and vkSumi Vulkan post-processing effects, and OptiScaler upscaling and frame generation. It also covers Proton environment tweaks and per-game overrides. It writes the config files and produces launch commands to paste into Steam or Lutris. Per-game settings live in separate XDG config directories, and a Game Mode switches the launch command box to a game-specific bgmod command with %command% suffix. The project also bundles PasCube, a Vulkan demo used to preview overlay settings. The bgmod wrapper is a compiled Free Pascal binary that sets environment variables, Wine DLL overrides and upscaler files on launch, with an accompanying uninstaller.
use_cases: enable DLSS or FSR upscaling with OptiScaler on Linux
generate Steam launch options for games
preview Vulkan overlay settings in real time
notable: Card-based Qt6 GUI that generates MangoHud, vkBasalt and OptiScaler configs without hand-editing files
Per-game Game Mode with separate XDG config directories and a game-specific launch command
bgmod wrapper binary written in Free Pascal, replacing the older fgmod bash approach, with a matching uninstaller that restores backups
Integrated PasCube Vulkan demo for previewing overlay settings
Available as Flathub, AppImage, distro packages and tarball
caveats: Flatpak hides host-dependent features such as GameMode and Protontricks
Fedora, Debian and Ubuntu official repositories often ship outdated versions; Flatpak or AppImage recommended
Since version 0.6.4 MangoHud must be installed to run Goverlay
